topics.justification: Top terms like "image", "jpeg", "steganography", "pixel", "header", and "compression" point to hiding or encoding information inside image formats and dealing with detectability and compression effects.
Words such as "zip", "zip_file", "executable", "extension", "open", "write", and "folder" suggest questions about bundling, distributing, opening, and executing code/files via archives.

The cluster "git", "commit", "object", "blob", "tag", "hash", "sign", and "trust" indicates Git’s content-addressing model and integrity/authenticity via hashing and signing (including collision concerns).
High weights for "file", "encrypt", "password", "decrypt", "archive", and "key" point to encrypting/decrypting files (often archives) using passwords/keys and handling contents/filenames.
Terms like "command", "script", "error", "test", "output", "public_key", "private_key", and "decrypt" suggest debugging or validating cryptographic operations via CLI/tools and keypair usage.

topics.topic_name: File checksums and hash verification (MD5, collisions)
topics.justification: "file", "hash", "checksum", "compare", "verify", "md5", and "collision" clearly indicate computing and checking hashes to verify downloads/integrity and discussing collision/duplicate implications.

topics.topic_name: Secure file transfer & server/client threat model
topics.justification: The mix of "download", "server", "client", "attacker", "prevent", "upload", and "secure/security" points to protecting file transfer workflows from tampering or unauthorized access.
Top words "signature", "pdf", "document", "certificate", "verify", and "field" indicate adding/extracting/verifying signatures within PDF/document structures using certificates.

topics.topic_name: Streaming large-file I/O for encryption (chunked processing)
topics.justification: "byte", "read", "write", "chunk", "stream", "memory", "size", and "mb" point to processing large files efficiently (often for encryption) using chunked/streaming reads and writes.

topics.topic_name: Data change tracking, backups, and tamper evidence (conceptual)
topics.justification: Words like "change", "copy", "backup", "store", "tool", and "impossible/hard" suggest higher-level discussions about detecting changes, maintaining copies/backups, and limits of preventing data modification.

topics.topic_name: Encryption algorithm parameters (block/bit size, modes, security/performance)
topics.justification: "algorithm", "block", "bit", "mode", "plaintext", "attack", "implementation", and "fast/slow" indicate discussions about cipher design/parameters and the security-performance tradeoffs of modes and sizes.
